The ground truth of this sector

Operators see Achala Ledger as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not, fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
Bring one shared-record problem to a briefing. We will show the network, the consensus rules and the inspection views it would run with.
